name: read-thread
description: Reads a Slack message thread, the parent message first and the replies oldest first, each with its ts, user id, text and reactions. Takes the channel by name or id (list-channels lists them) and the parent message's ts, which read-channel-history answers.

channel.description: A channel name, with or without the leading #, or a channel id from list-channels.

threadTs.description: The ts of the thread's parent message, from read-channel-history.

limit.description: Maximum number of thread messages to return.
